items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...a friend of mine, Sara Fishko produced... [INTERVIEWEE] Really?

ctx.x: On occasion. Not that frequently I think. I think Zoot was kind of a standard player there. Jim Hall, Jim Rainey, and those kind of guys.

Bill Crow, Brookmeyer, and Warne I guess on occasion. There was also a radio series a year or so ago on WNYC, a friend of mine, Sara Fishko produced, and they did a ten show series on the jazz loft and they did a whole episode on Ronnie Free.
